# gigahost_regions (Data Source)

Lists all deploy regions. Same data as `gigahost deploy regions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all deploy regions; same data as `gigahost deploy regions`.
data "gigahost_regions" "all" {}

output "region_slugs" {
  value = data.gigahost_regions.all.regions[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
